environment.description: Provider API server deployed on an EC2 instance in a private subnet, exposed via an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 8443. The NLB performs TCP passthrough with no TLS termination or client authentication. Security group allows inbound 8443 from 10.0.0.0/8. Any host in the VPC can reach the API directly.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough, no TLS
